title: Laura and Whitney Plantation Tour with Private Transportation
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)
This tour does NOT include a meal. Snacks and drinks available for purchase.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a small narrated private tour by van, for groups of up to 13 travelers. At Whitney Plantation's Louisiana Museum of Slavery, see the harsh realities and raw historical facts of a dark side of American history. The slave narratives and artwork recreate the world of a pre-Civil War southern sugar plantation and memorial in honor of the lives of the enslaved people who toiled there. A short ride through sugar cane fields brings you to Laura, a Creole Plantation with historic slave quarters surrounded by sugar cane fields.
